name: app-6aa8d7226d208191bd29a6211fad2019
description: Find tours, activities, and hotels for your trip. Browse experiences with images, ratings, starting prices, options, and direct links. Search hotels for your dates and occupancy with point-in-time supplier rates, room details, and ratings, or check dated activity times and prices. Over The Planet is read-only: it never books, charges, or reserves inventory.

defaultPrompt: Discover things to do in Tokyo, with photos and starting prices
Compare tours and activities in Rome by starting price, duration, and what’s included
Help me find a hotel in Bali for two adults—ask for my travel dates first
interface.longDescription: Find tours, activities, and hotels for your trip. Browse experiences with images, ratings, starting prices, options, and direct links. Search hotels for your dates and occupancy with point-in-time supplier rates, room details, and ratings, or check dated activity times and prices. Over The Planet is read-only: it never books, charges, or reserves inventory.

positive.prompt: Find experiences in Sydney for 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-03.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_experiences for Sydney without queryText/activityName, using the user's currency preference or the configured default. Then call get_listed_experience_availability exactly once with all publicIds returned by that search page, the requested dates, and occupancy ["2"]. These are availability details previously recorded by Over The Planet and have not been confirmed with providers for the requested dates; do not call check_experience_availability once per product or claim that missing availability details mean sold out. If two or more usable experiences remain, always call render_travel_cards once with 2–8 selected results and exact returned facts. Explain the limitation in plain language and avoid implementation terminology; do not finish with a prose-only list.

positive.prompt: Find a hotel in Sydney for two adults from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-04.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_hotels with Sydney, checkIn 2026-11-01, checkOut 2026-11-04, occupancy ["2"], and AUD or the user's currency. If two or more usable hotels are returned, always call render_travel_cards once with 2–8 selected hotels, showing their images, ratings, returned live rates, estimated-rate caveats, and direct links without claiming a booking.

positive.prompt: Check whether Sydney Harbour BridgeClimb is available on 2026-11-01 for two adults, including times and prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_experiences with destination Sydney and queryText containing the original named-activity request (optionally activityName Sydney Harbour BridgeClimb), then call check_experience_availability with the single high-confidence returned publicId, startDate 2026-11-01, and occupancy ["2"]. Finally call render_travel_cards once for that activity with returned availability/time/price highlights, image, and direct URL; state that availability is point-in-time and no booking was made. If no live slots are returned, clearly state that no availability was returned for that date; do not invent times or prices or infer permanent unavailability.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about Sydney Harbour BridgeClimb.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_experiences with destination Sydney and the named activity wording in queryText, then call get_experience_details with the high-confidence returned publicId. Return practical details and preserved address data, and call render_travel_cards once for the activity if a visual card helps; use only returned facts and the direct Over The Planet URL.

positive.prompt: What options are sold for Sydney Harbour BridgeClimb?
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_experiences with destination Sydney and the named activity wording, then call get_experience_options with the returned publicId. Identify the activity by name, call render_travel_cards once with the activity and up to four returned option/price highlights, include the direct detail URL, and explain that catalogue options are not live-slot confirmation.

negative.prompt: Book activity 4l2N67MpQEH and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin is read-only and direct the user to the returned Over The Planet page.

negative.prompt: Find me the cheapest flight from Sydney to Tokyo.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a tool; explain that the plugin covers destination activities, not flights.

negative.prompt: What visa do I need to enter Japan?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call a tool; explain that the plugin does not provide visa or immigration advice.

publication.release_notes: Version 3.0.1 corrects the unsupported Activity.description selection in hosted experience-search queries (hotfix 76f93180). Adds destination-diverse Tokyo/Rome/Bali starter prompts and explicit November 2026 review dates. Hosted MCP reports its separate adapter version 0.3.0; package version 3.0.1 follows the uploaded portal manifest 3.0.0. No booking, payment or reservation capability is added. Improves named-activity follow-up matching by excluding conversational words, using clean activity names for lookup/ranking, rejecting weak candidates, and checking one bounded destination page when the name index misses a partial title.
